cases.title: A valid unexpired code reduces the order total by the code amount
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The acceptance criterion holds: A valid unexpired code reduces the order total by the code amount
cases.expected: the order total shows the discount

cases.title: An expired code is rejected and the total stays unchanged
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The acceptance criterion holds: An expired code is rejected and the total stays unchanged
cases.expected: The system refuses the action and leaves protected totals unchanged.

cases.title: A second code is rejected while one code is already applied
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The acceptance criterion holds: A second code is rejected while one code is already applied
cases.expected: The system refuses the action and leaves protected totals unchanged.

cases.title: promo_code length 4 is accepted
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
cases.expected: The value is accepted.

cases.title: promo_code length 3 is rejected
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
cases.expected: The value is rejected with a validation message.

cases.title: promo_code length 12 is accepted
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
cases.expected: The value is accepted.

cases.title: promo_code length 13 is rejected
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
cases.expected: The value is rejected with a validation message.

cases.title: promo_code is empty and is rejected
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
cases.expected: The value is rejected with a validation message.

cases.title: promo: empty --apply_valid--> applied
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The promo state is empty and apply_valid happens
cases.expected: The state is applied.

cases.title: promo: applied --apply_second--> applied
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The promo state is applied and apply_second happens
cases.expected: The event is rejected and the state stays applied.

cases.title: promo: applied --remove--> empty
cases.preconditions: A shopper can apply one promo code at checkout
steps: The promo state is applied and remove happens
cases.expected: The state is empty.

cases.title: Carts at or above 75.00 in the US show free shipping
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
steps: The acceptance criterion holds: Carts at or above 75.00 in the US show free shipping
cases.expected: the shipping line shows the price from the rule

cases.title: cart_total at minimum 0 is accepted
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: The value is accepted.

cases.title: cart_total below minimum (-0.01) is rejected
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: The value is rejected with a validation message.

cases.title: cart_total at maximum 10000 is accepted
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: The value is accepted.

cases.title: cart_total above maximum (10000.01) is rejected
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: The value is rejected with a validation message.

cases.title: rule country=US cart_total=74.99 -> standard shipping
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: standard shipping

cases.title: rule country=US cart_total=75.00 -> free shipping
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: free shipping

cases.title: rule country=CA cart_total=75.00 -> standard shipping
cases.preconditions: A shopper can see the shipping price the cart actually qualifies for
cases.expected: standard shipping

cases.title: A dated estimate is visible before the pay button
cases.preconditions: A shopper can read an estimated delivery date before paying
steps: The acceptance criterion holds: A dated estimate is visible before the pay button
cases.expected: the checkout page shows the estimated delivery date
